test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

PMRF, PDZV, PUHL, PLPB, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabet & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

First alphabet is placed as same,

**Second alphabet is decreased by - 9, **

**Third alphabet is increased by + 8,**

**Fourth alphabet is decreased by - 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55d4241dbab2939f6751e9da38ed0a7dc018bfc0f84d0a3602421ef7cc841501.png] 

So, **PCXR will complete the series.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
